svg.title: PBE — Same-GPU Prefill / Decode Sharing
svg.desc: Two independent processes borrow one immutable weight allocation and semantically compatible KV pages from the data service. Workspace and request state remain private.
svg.text: PBE | Same-GPU Prefill / Decode Sharing
Independent processes · Framework-owned memory · Private execution state
ONE GPU
TP=1 · Compatible BF16 language model
SHARED IMMUTABLE WEIGHTS
Data service owns ONE physical allocation; P and D import the SAME allocation via CUDA IPC.
One upload · Compatible model / layout / device identity · Separate consumer leases
Prefill process — PID P
Decode process — PID D
Computes prompt KV and publishes handoff
Restores KV page table and runs Decode
PRIVATE: workspace · activations · scheduler
Request state and writable tail pages
PRIVATE: workspace · activations · scheduler
Request state and writable tail pages
Typed P→D handoff: KV identity + generation + page metadata + decode start state
PAGED KV POOL — PHYSICAL OWNERSHIP: DATA SERVICE
Reuse requires matching prefix semantics. Shared tail writes require COW; private does not mean process-owned allocation.
Leases + generation + completion fences govern access and reclamation
1. Publish after upload completes
2. Attach views before compute
3. Drain before releasing memory
Shared weights reduce duplication. Workspaces, CUDA contexts and GPU contention still have a cost.
Read-only is a trusted-worker contract, not hardware protection. Exporter failure requires fail-stop recovery.
Conceptual 1P1D deployment · No claim of arbitrary worker scaling or throughput improvement
